t: What Sustainable Materials Substitution Database Is All About
title: What Sustainable Materials Substitution Database Is All About
description: Substitution replaces high-impact materials with lower-impact ones that still do the job: bamboo flooring for hardwood, recycled steel for virgin, mycelium packaging for styrofoam. Honest substitution needs life-cycle assessment — a 'green' alternative that fails early or ships halfway around the world may lose. The rule: match performance first, then count the footprint over the full life. This database is the complete material substitution: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Sustainable Materials Substitution Database: a complete reference database of full material substitution records.
key_points: What this database holds: full material substitution records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

t: Core Vocabulary of Sustainable Materials Substitution Database

description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Sustainable Materials Substitution Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: life-cycle assessment: full-chain environmental accounting; embodied carbon: CO2 from making a material; cradle-to-grave: from extraction to disposal; functional unit: the service being compared.
definition: The working vocabulary of Sustainable Materials Substitution Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: life-cycle assessment: full-chain environmental accounting
embodied carbon: CO2 from making a material
cradle-to-grave: from extraction to disposal
functional unit: the service being compared
greenwashing: misleading environmental claims
circular economy: keeping materials in use
